title: From Delivery Excellence to a Scaled Growth & Transformation Hub
summary: Discover how cross-skilling, ix Hero automation and digital transformation drove 350% revenue growth and improved customer experience.
body_markdown:
*Building the next phase of growth through talent, technology and transformation.*


India had an opportunity to move beyond core service delivery and become a hub for specialist capabilities, higher-value work and sustained business growth. Achieving this required a more versatile workforce, the integration of automation into service delivery and a stronger digital foundation to improve customer experience, efficiency and operational outcomes.
